text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'First-named arm's mean absolute error minus the second's. The season rows re-score the models fitted on every month. Every calendar month weighted equally: the mean, over the 12 calendar months, of each month's mean difference. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from resampling whole calendar months and a fitting seed. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output. Three wind farms in Lincolnshire, August 2024 to December 2025: 34,156 farm-hours in 17 calendar months. Three farms are few independent sites. Planned: one of the comparisons written into the study plan before any result existed. Every other row is exploratory.'
